objective: Own high-intent Traverse City grape searches with producer-level varietal evidence connected to ranking, comparison, winery guides, and route planning.
qualityRules: Grape pages rank winery fit instead of publishing static best-of copy.
Producer-level varietal claims require a source URL, source label, and verification date.
Winery guides show the source of verified varietal lists.
The comparator uses verified varietals where available.
New grape routes are linked from the homepage, winery guides, related wine pages, analytics, and sitemap.
Publisher authority and all prior wine-product CI checks remain active.
